---
id: docs-index-stage-allowlist
type: trap
status: active
---
`scripts/docs-index.sh:37` rejects any `.md` under `docs/` whose folder is not one of the four
declared lifecycle stages, exiting 2 and failing `make check`.

**Why:** the index is generated by reading each doc's TRIAGE header, so an unstaged file has no
row to generate and the script refuses to invent one rather than list it under a made-up stage.

**How to apply:** a new non-lifecycle subtree under `docs/` needs adding to the skip list at
`scripts/docs-index.sh:30` in the same commit that creates it, or every file in it fails the
gate. `templates/`, `README.md`, `accepted_risks.md`, and the memory tree are already skipped.
